1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game based on IDEA.md
2: // Assumes an HTML <canvas id="game"></canvas> exists.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7: 
8:   // Set canvas size (fallback to 800x600 if not set via CSS)
9:   canvas.width = canvas.width || 800;
10:   canvas.height = canvas.height || 600;
11: 
12:   // Ship definition
13:   const ship = {
14:     width: 40,
15:     height: 20,
16:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
17:     y: canvas.height - 30,
18:     speed: 5,
19:     movingLeft: false,
20:     movingRight: false,
21:   };
22: 
23:   // Asteroid definition
24:   const asteroids = [];
25:   let asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
26:   let lastSpawn = 0;
27:   let asteroidSpeed = 2; // initial fall speed, will increase over time
28: 
29:   let score = 0;
30:   let gameOver = false;
31: 
32:   // Input handling
33:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
34:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') ship.movingLeft = true;
35:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') ship.movingRight = true;
36:   });
37:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
38:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') ship.movingLeft = false;
39:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') ship.movingRight = false;
40:   });
41: 
42:   function spawnAsteroid() {
43:     const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 10;
44:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - radius * 2) + radius;
45:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -radius, radius, speed: asteroidSpeed });
46:   }
47: 
48:   function update(dt) {
49:     // Move ship
50:     if (ship.movingLeft) ship.x = Math.max(0, ship.x - ship.speed);
51:     if (ship.movingRight) ship.x = Math.min(canvas.width - ship.width, ship.x + ship.speed);
52: 
53:     // Spawn asteroids based on interval
54:     if (Date.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
55:       spawnAsteroid();
56:       lastSpawn = Date.now();
57:       // Gradually increase difficulty
58:       asteroidSpeed += 0.05;
59:       asteroidSpawnInterval = Math.max(300, asteroidSpawnInterval - 10);
60:     }
61: 
62:     // Update asteroids
63:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
64:       const a = asteroids[i];
65:       a.y += a.speed;
66:       // Remove if off screen
67:       if (a.y - a.radius > canvas.height) {
68:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
69:         score++;
70:       }
71:     }
72: 
73:     // Collision detection
74:     for (const a of asteroids) {
75:       const shipRect = { x: ship.x, y: ship.y, w: ship.width, h: ship.height };
76:       const distX = Math.abs(a.x - (shipRect.x + shipRect.w / 2));
77:       const distY = Math.abs(a.y - (shipRect.y + shipRect.h / 2));
78: 
79:       if (distX <= shipRect.w / 2 + a.radius && distY <= shipRect.h / 2 + a.radius) {
80:         // Simple AABB-circle hit test
81:         gameOver = true;
82:         break;
83:       }
84:     }
85:   }
86: 
87:   function draw() {
88:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
89: 
90:     // Draw ship (simple rectangle)
91:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
92:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.width, ship.height);
93: 
94:     // Draw asteroids
95:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a52a2a';
96:     for (const a of asteroids) {
97:       ctx.beginPath();
98:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
99:       ctx.fill();
100:     }
101: 
102:     // Draw score
103:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
104:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
105:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 30);
106: 
107:     // Game over overlay
108:     if (gameOver) {
109:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
110:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
111:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
112:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
113:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
114:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
115:     }
116:   }
117: 
118:   let lastTime = 0;
119:   function loop(timestamp) {
120:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
121:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
122:     lastTime = timestamp;
123: 
124:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
125:     draw();
126: 
127:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
128:   }
129: 
130:   // Start the loop
131:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
132: })();

(End of file - total 132 lines)
</content>
